decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 1 heading sits at a level the page never opens — "All Webinars are presented on Tuesdays/Thursdays" is an h4 with no h3 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 4 headings are plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 3 links on this page open a file — 3 Excel — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Put the buttons on the house style
decisions.why: 1 button uses a Bootstrap variant rather than btn-info, so the same kind of action is drawn three different ways across the site. Only the class changes.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
